acceptance: Normal SDK and test callers use CompilationSession::with_standard_packages for ordinary single-source inputs.
Cold and cached operation-aware session queries preserve legacy FullWithStandardPackages diagnostics.
Direct analyzer calls remain only in named exceptional compatibility fixtures.
Project capture owns bounded, confined manifest and source-tree reads.
Compiler package assembly consumes captured bytes and does not reimplement traversal.
The remaining legacy dependency/review/native resolver is explicitly documented until migrated.
The Linux reference runner applies its declared process-isolation controls before execution.
Runner control failures are reported separately from VM termination reasons.
Tests exercise the supported Linux control path and fail closed when controls are unavailable.
The example compiles, verifies, links explicit providers, executes with limits, and emits an execution report.
The same artifact is exercised with replaceable provider implementations.
The example documents its snapshot and artifact identity.
